set.description: Express n>1 uniquely as a product of prime powers and use exponents for divisibility, perfect powers, greatest common divisors, and least common multiples.
set.name: Prime factorization and exponent structure
set.nameZh: 质因数分解与指数结构

criteria: 能用部分除以总数
能把得数写成百分数
set.description: 会求一个数是另一个数的百分之几。
set.name: Calculating percentage rates

criteria: 能判断是否是因式分解
能说出与乘法的关系
set.description: 把一个多项式化为几个整式的积叫因式分解，它与整式乘法互为逆运算。
set.name: Concept of Factorization

criteria: 能把相同加数的连加改写成乘法
能读出乘法算式
set.description: 知道乘法是求几个相同加数的和，认识乘号，会读写乘法算式。
set.name: The Meaning of Multiplication

set.reason: Extracting a common factor must produce a product equivalent to the original polynomial; factorization meaning specifies the goal.
set.scope: Recognizing the goal of factoring

set.reason: A factor and a multiple are defined through a product a×b=c. Finding factor pairs and listing multiples both presuppose understanding what a multiplication equation states.
set.scope: factor and multiple defined via products

set.reason: Expressing the increase divided by the original as a percent is a particular percent-rate computation.
set.scope: expressing increase over original as a percent

set.reason: Comparing prime exponents settles perfect-power and multiplicative equations. Linear or bounded integer equations are solved through divisibility, bounds or search, without unique factorization.
set.scope: prime-exponent route for multiplicative equations

set.reason: The node uses exponents to settle divisibility, gcd and lcm, which are stated in terms of factors and multiples. The factor concept is indispensable, though exhaustive factor listing is not.
set.scope: divisibility meaning of factors and multiples

criteria: Use integrality to restrict possible values.
Find all solutions in the requested integer domain.
set.description: Solve equations subject to integer restrictions using divisibility, factor pairs, congruences, or finite bounds; justify completeness.
set.name: Integer solutions of equations

criteria: 能先求出增加或减少的量
能把增加量除以原来的数写成百分数
set.description: 会解决求一个数比另一个数多百分之几、增长率这类简单问题。
set.name: Applications of Percentages

criteria: 能找出两个数全部公因数
能说出最大公因数
set.description: 会求两个数的公因数和最大公因数。
set.name: Greatest common factor

criteria: 能找出公因式
提取后括号内项数不变
set.description: 找出各项的公因式（系数的最大公约数与相同字母最低次幂），提到括号外。
set.name: Factoring Out the Common Factor

criteria: 能找出一个不太大的数的全部因数
能说出谁是谁的倍数
set.description: 知道因数和倍数是相互依存的，会找一个数的因数和 100 以内的倍数。
set.name: Factors and multiples
